projects.title: Books -> Movies (AI-film flywheel)
projects.description_md:
VISION / ROADMAP (Research stage; no heavy build yet). Books become MOVIES -- AI-produced, promoted IN-APP exclusively for subscribers, grounded in the information of Yahweh (the Word + truth) plus Darrell's and the community's real content feeds.

Flywheel extension: same corpus, new medium. book/teaching/Scripture (lane local_7bcac1a3) -> screenplay/scene-treatment (sovereign Ollama) -> narration in CONSENTED voices (tts.js seam; voice lane local_da7f0d36) -> AI 'moving picture' (LABELED AI; theological review) -> subscriber-exclusive in-app release -> feedback refines the next retelling. Re-uses the no-video-lost harvest ledger discipline (a film is another derived artifact with provenance, never painted).

Honest hardware truth: photoreal multi-minute film is NOT feasible on the church 2x RTX 4070 (12GB) today (full-quality open video models are 24GB->datacenter; quantized local gen yields ~4-5s clips). So crawl in a sovereign-feasible medium NOW (narrated illustrated/motion + consented voices) and walk/run into true AI video as the planned bigger CUDA box (5090-class, 32GB) lands and open models (Wan 2.2/2.7, HunyuanVideo 1.5, LTX-2.3 -- all Apache-2.0) mature. Vendor APIs (Veo/Sora/Kling/Wan) kept as a GATED, opt-in burst lane for non-sovereign promo only -- never the canonical generator of Word-grounded content.

BINDING integrity guardrails (from first frame): (1) AI-generated film ALWAYS labeled 'AI-generated'; (2) likeness + voice CONSENT required -- no realistic depiction of a real person's face/voice without explicit, written, scoped, revocable consent (extends the voice-consent rule to faces; Darrell's own = consented; likeness consent is SEPARATE from voice consent and not assumed); (3) no deceptive realism -- never depict a real person saying/doing what they didn't, never present generated footage as documentary fact; (4) child-appropriate by default; (5) mission-aligned -- every film passes the theological review pipeline + the Test (souls + the Word, not spectacle).

Phasing: P0 capture the vision (this card; now). P1 CRAWL -- narrated illustrated/motion shorts + consented voices on the 4070 (doable now; gated on an in-app exclusive player + the subscription/90-day-free billing engine, neither built yet). P2 WALK -- short AI video clips woven in (gated on the 5090-class box). P3 RUN -- richer AI film (gated on compute + model maturity). Re-review trigger: bigger CUDA box stands up AND a sovereign video-gen clip clears a real quality bar on a real device (verify-don't-claim).

Full roadmap + cited tech survey + dependencies: docs/99-session-notes/2026-06-25-books-to-movies-ai-film-flywheel-research-review.md . Senior foundation: docs/00-foundations/_root/AI-MEDIA-PRODUCTION-PLATFORM-VISION.md (this is its first concrete book->film extension).
